description: The top-level packages an uploaded model file may import. The backend's upload scan (Bandit plugin TBT001) refuses an upload whose file imports any other top-level name -- standard library included (typing, copy, os, ...) -- unless the name is a sibling file of the same upload. A template is a single file, so for the zoo this list is exact. Read by tests/test_upload_import_allowlist.py.
